simple.meaning: מָשׂוֹשׂ (mâsôws) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “delight , concretely (the cause or object) or abstractly (the feeling).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 17 times across Job, Psalms, Isaiah, Jeremiah, Lamentations, and 2 more, beginning at Job 8:19. Its contexts include family line, land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מָשׂוֹשׂ (H4885).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: מָשׂוֹשׂ (mâsôws) / H4885 is traced through Job 8:19, Psalms 48:3, Isaiah 8:6, Isaiah 24:8 as a generated source-based concept entry.

timeline.evidenceText: Behold, this is the joy of his way:
God has shown himself in her citadels as a refuge.
“Because this people has refused the waters of Shiloah that go softly, and rejoice in Rezin and Remaliah’s son;
The mirth of tambourines ceases. The sound of those who rejoice ends. The joy of the harp ceases.
The mirth of tambourines ceases. The sound of those who rejoice ends. The joy of the harp ceases.
There is a crying in the streets because of the wine. All joy is darkened. The mirth of the land is gone.
Thorns and briers will come up on my people’s land;
For the palace will be forsaken.
“Whereas you have been forsaken and hated,
For as a young man marries a virgin,
But be glad and rejoice forever in that which I create;
“Rejoice with Jerusalem, and be glad for her, all you who love her.
How is the city of praise not forsaken,
All that pass by clap their hands at you.
The joy of our heart has ceased.

“You, son of man, shouldn’t it be in the day when I take from them their strength, the joy of their glory, the desire of their eyes, and that whereupon they set their heart, their sons and their daughters,
I will visit on her the days of the Baals,

definitions.full: H4885. masos מָשׂוֺשׂ noun masculine : Isa 24:8 id.; — absolute ׳מ 32:13 +, construct מְשׂוֺשׂ Job 8:19 +; suffix מְשׂוֺשִׂי Jer 49:25 , מְשׂוֺשָׂהּ Hosea 2:13 ; — exultation , in General, Lam 5:15 (opposed to אֵבֶל ), Isa 24:11 ; 66:10 (accusative of congnate meaning with verb); of bridegroom 62:5 ; ׳מ תֻּמִּיס , 24:8 , ׳מ בִנּוֺר 24:8 ; מ ׳בָּתֵּי 33:13 ; of Jerusalem (as causing joy) 60:15 ; Psa 48:3 ; Lam 2:15 , compare Jer 49:25 ( מְשׂוֺשִׂי קִרְיַת ; || תְּהִלָּה ), Isa 65:18 (|| גִּילָה ); ׳מ דַּרְבּוֺ (of godless man) Job 8:19 ; ׳מ מְּרָאִים Isa 32:14 , i.e. desert. — ׳מ 8:6 , si vera lectio, is construct before preposition, but ( מִמְּנֵי ) מָסוֺס , Hi Gie Che Du Kit Marti and others שֵׂחַ see שִׂיח
